items.title: 卓驭端到端 4.0 落地红旗，数据驱动「泛化」战打响
items.raw_excerpt: 3 月13 日，智驾方案商卓驭在深圳举办了“高悟性端到端 4.0”体验日。在这座以路况复杂著称的城市，卓驭试图通过对老城区窄路、人车混行街区的实测，验证其最新版本 OTA 在真实环境中的处理能力。 在深圳南头古城片区，极窄的城中村道路与盲区频现的十字路口，构成了智驾系统的考场。实测显示，卓驭端到端 4.0 在处理这些无法穷尽规则的场景时，表现出了明显的拟人化特征。 最典型的例子是系统对博弈的理解。在双向单车道的狭窄缝隙中，车辆能与对向来车进行空间博弈，灵巧绕开临停车辆。此外，其“端到端驱动三点式掉头”，让车辆在断头路等极端环境下，能像老司机一样自主规划路径并完成多次揉库，全程无需接管。 这种进化的核心逻辑在于彻底抛弃规则代码。 “业界许多方案中还有不少是规则代码在起作用。而端到端 4.0 是真正让数据说话。”卓驭科技产品总监蒋卓键表示。所谓“100% 端味”，意味着从感知到决策再到控制的完整链条中，以往依赖的大量人工预设规则已被拿掉，取而代之的是由海量数据训练出的 AI 大模型。 传统基于规则的系统如同一个拿着指令手册的操作员，遇到手册外的情况便会不知所措，而端到端模型则更像是一个通过大量实战学习经验的驾驶者，在面对未知场景时能做出更合理的自主决策。 端到端模型的成熟并非一蹴而就，其底层逻辑是卓驭构建的“双闭环”研发范式：数据闭环通过对真实行车数据的回收、清洗与标注，不断喂养模型；体验闭环则是验证过的模型上车后，利用量产车源源不断回传的长尾问题和场景数据，反哺模型优化。 这种纯粹的数据驱动路径，解决了智驾体验从“可用”到“好用”的关键障碍——确定性。更深层的意义在于，这种进化是在不改变硬件平台的前提下实现的。 随着高悟性端到端 4.0 的发布，卓驭也明确了该技术将率先落地红旗“司南智驾”，并于今年上半年通过 OTA 陆续推送给红旗 HS6 PHEV、天工 05 等多款车型。

On March 13, autonomous driving solution provider Zhuoyu held an "Advanced End-to-End 4.0" experience day in Shenzhen. In this city known for its complex road conditions, Zhuoyu aimed to validate the real-world performance of its latest OTA version through tests in narrow roads of old urban areas and mixed-traffic streets. In Shenzhen's Nantou Ancient City area, extremely narrow village roads and intersections with frequent blind spots served as the testing ground for the autonomous driving system. The tests revealed that Zhuoyu's End-to-End 4.0 exhibited distinct human-like characteristics when handling scenarios with inexhaustible rules.  

A prime example is the system's understanding of negotiation. In narrow two-way single-lane gaps, the vehicle could engage in spatial negotiation with oncoming traffic, skillfully maneuvering around temporarily parked vehicles. Additionally, its "end-to-end-driven three-point U-turn" enabled the vehicle to autonomously plan paths and execute multiple parking adjustments in extreme environments like dead-end roads, mimicking an experienced driver without requiring any intervention.  

The core logic behind this evolution lies in completely abandoning rule-based code. "Many industry solutions still rely heavily on rule-based code, but End-to-End 4.0 truly lets data drive decisions," said Jiang Zhuojian, Product Director at Zhuoyu Technology. The so-called "100% end-to-end" approach means that, throughout the entire chain from perception to decision-making and control, the extensive reliance on manually preset rules has been replaced by AI models trained on massive datasets.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 就在前天，字节豆包团队官宣：豆包要做手机助手了。 豆包手机助手，是字节和手机厂商合作，基于操作系统层面的授权落地的ai助手。背靠在推理、视觉、图像视频创作、语音等多方面国际领先的豆包大模型，豆包手机助手给用户带来的，是交互和体验层面的关键创新。 豆包手机助手，是字节入局手机生意的前夜吗？豆包官方给出了明确的否定：豆包没有自研手机的计划。当下的豆包手机助手，是以生态合作的方式，将软件技术整合进不同品牌的机型，而豆包也正在与多家手机厂商洽谈。 今天，豆包手机助手开放体验的手机机型，是字节和中兴合作的工程样机 nubia M153，这款手机也已面向开发者和科技爱好者少量发售，能够让他们体验豆包手机助手的技术预览版本，售价 3499 元。 别小看豆包的这次“转身”，手机助手对于大模型的产品化落地，意义相当深远。 最直接的变化，是用户使用豆包手机助手，变得更加简单方便了。 首先，是用户离豆包更“近”了。用户用语音、手机侧边的“AI 键”，或是豆包 OlaFriend 耳机，就能直接调出豆包，帮助自己答疑解惑，甚至直接开始 AI 语音通话。而在用户授权后，AI 甚至可以直接识别手机屏幕的内容，更直接地理解用户意图，也帮用户省掉了“截图”“发送”的两步操作。 而针对用户需求充沛的 AI 修图功能，豆包的 AI 能力也融入了系统的原生相册，点开相册，用户可以直接用语音下达修图指令，清除照片上的路人、杂物不在话下。 今年最热的 AI 应用，莫过于被 Manus 带火了的多 Agent 协作框架，而这一点在手机端，单凭一个 App 却很难做到。在系统层面上的打通，让豆包手机助手向着 AI 的“一站式完成交付”更进了一步——根据用户的指令，豆包手机助手可以操作手机，实现多款应用间的自动跳转。 演示视频中，用户仅凭一张图片，就能自动识别出商品，并在多个购物软件上比价、挑选出最便宜的商品链接，最终再
excerpt_i18n.en: Just the day before yesterday, ByteDance's Doubao team officially announced that Doubao is launching a mobile assistant. The Doubao Mobile Assistant is an AI assistant developed by ByteDance in collaboration with smartphone manufacturers, implemented through operating system-level authorization. Backed by the internationally leading Doubao large model, which excels in reasoning, vision, image and video creation, voice, and other areas, the Doubao Mobile Assistant brings users key innovations in interaction and experience. Is the Doubao Mobile Assistant a prelude to ByteDance entering the smartphone business? Doubao officials have given a clear denial: Doubao has no plans to develop its own smartphones. Currently, the Doubao Mobile Assistant integrates software technology into devices of different brands through ecosystem partnerships, and Doubao is in talks with multiple smartphone manufacturers. Today, the smartphone model open for experiencing the Doubao Mobile Assistant is the engineering prototype nubia M153, a collaboration between ByteDance and ZTE. This phone has also been released in limited quantities to developers and tech enthusiasts, allowing them to experience the technical preview version of the Doubao Mobile Assistant, priced at 3,499 yuan. Do not underestimate Doubao's "transformation" this time—the mobile assistant holds significant implications for the productization and implementation of large models. The most direct change is that using the Doubao Mobile Assistant has become simpler and more convenient for users. First, users are now "closer" to Doubao. With voice commands, the "AI button" on the side of the phone, or the Doubao OlaFriend earphones, users can directly summon Doubao to answer questions or even initiate AI voice calls. With user authorization, the AI can even directly recognize the content on the phone screen, making interactions more straightforward.
excerpt_i18n.es: Justo anteayer, el equipo de Doubao de ByteDance anunció oficialmente: Doubao se convertirá en asistente de móvil. Doubao Asistente de Móvil es un asistente de IA desarrollado por ByteDance en colaboración con fabricantes de teléfonos, implementado a nivel del sistema operativo con autorización correspondiente. Respaldado por el avanzado modelo de Doubao, líder internacional en razonamiento, visión, creación de imágenes y vídeo, voz y más, Doubao Asistente de Móvil ofrece a los usuarios innovaciones clave en interacción y experiencia. ¿Es Doubao Asistente de Móvil el preludio de la entrada de ByteDance en el negocio de los móviles? Doubao ha dado una negativa clara: no tienen planes de desarrollar su propio teléfono. Actualmente, Doubao Asistente de Móvil integra tecnología de software en modelos de diferentes marcas mediante colaboraciones ecológicas, y Doubao está en conversaciones con varios fabricantes de móviles.

items.raw_excerpt: 3月12日，萤石Stella星辰系列技术发布会在AWE上海新国际博览中心萤石展台启幕，以“蒸汽进化，AI新净界”为主题，重磅发布Stella星辰系列AI蒸汽洗地机器人。依托全球首创的双擎双热活水洗地方案与自研的萤石星辰世界模型，萤石实现清洁能力与AI技术的双重突破，引领清洁行业迈入6.0时代，为清洁市场注入颠覆性创新活力。   行业困局凸显，萤石Stella星辰系列直击用户痛点 当前扫地机器人行业已历经多代技术演进，但用户核心清洁痛点始终未能得到彻底解决。据行业普遍认可的技术分析，1.0至3.0时代处于“以脏拖脏”初级阶段，清洁力薄弱、水渍明显等问题突出；4.0时代的常温活水洗地模式，难以应对干湿混合垃圾；5.0时代的虽然将高温引入到洗地机中提升清洁效果，却仍受困于干湿混合垃圾处理、凝固污渍瓦解、重度油污清洁及细菌消杀四大核心难题，行业创新陷入瓶颈。   作为安全智能生活主流品牌，萤石以“萤石云+AI”为双核驱动，构建起完善的“2+5+N”产品生态，在智能视觉、AI算法及硬件研发领域积累了深厚的技术沉淀。基于对行业痛点与用户需求的精准洞察，萤石强势入局高端清洁市场，推出首次布局蒸汽洗地机器人赛道的高端旗舰产品——Stella星辰系列AI蒸汽洗地机器人。该系列凭借多项“自研”“首创”的技术优势，精准破解行业四大核心痛点，重新定义高端智能清洁的全新标准。 全球首创双擎双热活水洗地，一站式攻克清洁难题 萤石Stella星辰系列的核心竞争力，在于其独家搭载的全球首创双擎双热活水洗地方案。这一创新成果已获得尚普咨询颁发的“全球AI双擎蒸汽洗地机器人首创”市场地位声明，其技术创新性与行业领先性得到权威认可。该套方案由“BiCore Suction双擎分区直吸系统”与“HotSteam Wash澎湃蒸洗双热系统”协同构成，实现吸尘、洗地、自清洁全链路升级，彻底打破传统

excerpt_i18n.en:
On March 12, the Ezviz Stella Series Technology Launch commenced at the Ezviz booth at AWE Shanghai New International Expo Center. Under the theme "Steam Evolution, AI New Clean Frontier," the event unveiled the Stella Series AI Steam Mopping Robot. Leveraging the world's first dual-engine, dual-heat live water mopping solution and the self-developed Ezviz Stella World Model, Ezviz achieved dual breakthroughs in cleaning capability and AI technology, leading the cleaning industry into the 6.0 era and injecting disruptive innovation into the cleaning market.

Industry challenges highlight how the Ezviz Stella Series directly addresses user pain points. The floor-cleaning robot industry has undergone multiple generations of technological evolution, yet core user cleaning issues remain unresolved. According to widely recognized technical analysis, the 1.0 to 3.0 eras were in a primitive stage of "dirty mopping with dirt," plagued by weak cleaning power and noticeable water stains. The 4.0 era's room-temperature live water mopping mode struggled with mixed dry and wet waste. Although the 5.0 era introduced high temperature to enhance cleaning effectiveness, it still faced four core challenges: handling mixed dry and wet waste, dissolving solidified stains, cleaning heavy grease, and bacterial disinfection, leading to an innovation bottleneck in the industry.

As a mainstream brand in safe smart living, Ezviz, driven by the dual cores of "Ezviz Cloud + AI," has built a comprehensive "2+5+N" product ecosystem, accumulating deep technical expertise in intelligent vision, AI algorithms, and hardware R&D. Based on precise insights into industry pain points and user needs, Ezviz has forcefully entered the high-end cleaning market.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 12 de marzo, la conferencia de lanzamiento tecnológico de la serie Stella de Ezviz se inauguró en el stand de la marca en el Centro de Exposiciones Internacional de Shanghai de AWE, bajo el tema "Evolución del vapor, un nuevo mundo limpio con IA", presentando el robot limpiador de pisos con vapor AI de la serie Stella. Basándose en el esquema pionero mundial de limpieza con agua caliente activa de doble motor y doble calor, junto con el modelo de mundo estelar autodesarrollado por Ezviz, la marca logra un doble avance en capacidad de limpieza y tecnología de IA, liderando la industria de la limpieza hacia la era 6.0 e inyectando innovación disruptiva en el mercado. Los desafíos del sector se hacen evidentes, y la serie Stella de Ezviz aborda directamente los puntos críticos de los usuarios.
